index.meta.title: PurringBlocks Studio
index.about.heading: About RoldoStudio
index.about.desc: RoldoStudio is the independent creative force behind PurringBlocks. We're a small, passionate team dedicated to making cozy, high-quality mobile games.
index.about.card1.title: Feline Passion
index.about.card1.desc: Designed for cat lovers in every detail.
index.about.card2.title: Indie Quality
index.about.card2.desc: Handcrafted care and attention in every pixel we create.
index.about.card3.title: Everyday Magic
index.about.card3.desc: We bring peace, joy, and a touch of magic to your everyday life.
index.banner.heading: Perfectly Crafted Games
index.banner.desc: At Roldo Studios, we pour our love for video games and cozy design into every pixel. We believe mobile games should feel like a warm hug, a cup of tea, and a gentle purr in your pocket.
index.featured.heading: Our Featured Game
index.game.desc: Discover a relaxing puzzle experience where cute cat-shaped blocks fit perfectly. Beat levels, collect adorable feline companions, and enjoy a calming kawaii aesthetic!
index.game.feature2: Hundreds of levels with charming art
index.game.feature3: Lofi soundtrack to calm your mind
about.meta.title: About Us - RoldoStudio
about.hero.title: Meet the Team
about.hero.desc: We're a small group of cat and videogame enthusiasts, dedicated to creating the coziest, most purr-fect digital experiences.
about.member1.desc: The brain behind the logistics. Ivan makes sure every block is in place while coding new feline adventures.
about.member2.desc: Code wizard and optimization expert. If there's a bug, Ton will find it and turn it into an adorable feature.
about.member3.desc: Dream architect. Edu designs mechanics that feel like being wrapped in a warm blanket on a rainy day.
about.member4.desc: The team's magic brush. Joan brings our characters to life with vibrant colors and textures you can almost pet.
about.philosophy.heading: Our Philosophy
about.philosophy.love.title: Made with Love
about.philosophy.love.desc: Every pixel is placed with the care of petting a sleeping cat.
about.philosophy.wholesome.title: Wholesome Gameplay
about.philosophy.wholesome.desc: We prioritize peace of mind and joy over competitive stress.
